notes.title: Happy Summer Event
notes.notes:
Summer is here and so is a big update to noFrills Solitaire 
- with more frills than ever -

New Features:
- a brand new mode "Scorpion"
- finally a manual to clarify some obscure options/features
- undo and redo buttons in [b]beta stage[/b]. for now only available in spider and scorpion mode. Use at your own risk.
- 7 new achievements to ease the long stretch from 100 to 500
- more cardbacks as achievement rewards
- more music tracks as achievement rewards
- changed the shape of clubs to better distinguish from spades 
- improved colours of hearts and diamonds to make them easier to distinguish
- FPS restriction to extend battery life and lower power consumption

have fun
the CouchFox

notes.title: Cardbacks!!
notes.notes:
While time flies the CouchFox was busy too - checkout this list of improvements and bugfixes:
(if your suggestion is not part of it, stay tuned for the next update - it will also come with more achievement rewards)

Improvements:
[list]
[*] [b]Cardbacks[/b]: you can change cardbacks now! to start off there is one new cardback for all players and an extra one to unlock if you win a total of 10 games in any mode
[*] cardbacks can be switched on the start page
[*] [b]Simplified mode selection[/b]: all the modes can now be set and changed from the start page
[*] when in spider mode, the pyramid still lets you change the mode directly, but will ask for confirmation
[/list]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] shuffling in Klondike easy-mode now not only shows a pretty animation but actually does shuffle the card stack
[*] the pyramid and the gramophone have been rearranged to not interfere with the cards in play
[*] in spider mode cards facing down are no longer treated as part of a finished set - and thus are no longer automatically removed
[/list]

hope it helps
enjoy
the CouchFox

notes.title: Happy Lunar New Year of the Ox
notes.notes:
To celebrate the new Year of the Ox we have a little update to share with you:
- a temporary seasonal look to celebrate the beginning of the year of the ox
- fixed some rare bugs in spider
- added the option to swap aces and free cells in freecell
- added achievements for all different game modes

Note: to have a clean slate with the newly integrated steam stats for achievements it was necessary to squish all existing stats - and also because there were no separate ones for the different spider modes (due to an unfortunate lack of forsight) . Please don't feel discouraged but challenged

The CouchFox

notes.title: The big someFrills Update
notes.notes:
Not prepared for a klondike as harsh as reality itself? 
Play "nofrills Klondike" in "somefrills"-mode.
This will give you the following new options:
[list]
[*] choice of 1 or 3 card mode (on game board in the top right corner)
[*] option to shuffle remaining cards in stack (on game board in the top left corner)
[*] new finish button which appears when all cards are uncovered and on the board (under the gramophone)
[/list]

Additionally the following features have been added:
[list]
[*] toggle between nofrills and somefrills mode (click the "nofrills" title on the start board) 
[*] new drag&drop mode
[*] toggle between new drag&drop and click mode in settings (cog wheel on the top right of the start board)
[*] see your current win numbers on the start page (depending on current game mode)
[/list]
